zones.assembly: Short wide stepped pressure body, broad insulated front, deep aft engine well and dark-red occupation belt.
zones.bill: Dark warm alloy lacquer, pale machined casing courses, seated armor and ceramic mouth lip. Broad corners and proud courses catch the Look; no generic freighter clone.

zones.assembly: Six independent long slats on actual X-axis bearings above a dark heat-return well.
zones.bill: Mid-value fin cases, dark underside, narrow amber recessed return slots. Finite opening is sourced from preheat/burn/vent, never idle oscillation.

zones.assembly: Two seven-metre pressure casks outside the hull, supported by lower brackets and keyed break collars. Open longitudinal air gaps survive source and native compound.
zones.bill: Warm ivory ceramic insulation, gray end protection rings, dark red collar course and recessed sight glass. Same authored cask becomes the loose body; no decorative copy remains.

zones.assembly: Recessed rectangular prow throat inside four ceramic lip members, four thick coolant pipes supported between casks and hull, two housed rear drives.
zones.bill: Dark throat depth, restrained hot inner louvers, supported metal pipes and dark bell coamings. No luminous card or light floating ahead of the prow.

preflight.review: Actual Look top/chase/close; repair observed craft, then root publishes serially.

provenance: Original SpaceFace Forge source; no external geometry/media
